facts.fact: Treasury Cabinet Secretary John Mbadi says the e-GP system, launched on 1 July 2025, is operational across ministries, departments, agencies, county governments and state corporations.
Mbadi says there will be no exemptions in use of the e-GP system across ministries, departments, agencies, counties and state corporations.

KEN.note: Registration counts given, no tender or value figure.
Counties' budgets are being integrated into e-GP, but no office connection is stated.
